name: Chuppa Chappsu! Okuchi no Koibito
original_name: ChuッパChaップス! お口の恋人
source:
At an early age younger sister makes a promise to make a fellatio whenever protagonist desires, but it's the older sister who imbues main character with the love for fellatio. His days are full of chuppa sounds from morning till night.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
幼年时，妹妹曾许下只要主角愿意就口交的承诺，但真正让主角爱上口交的却是姐姐。他的日子从早到晚都充满了“chuppa”的声音。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
